annotation.title_clean: Decreto Supremo Nº 012-2026-MTC que aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley Nº 30740, Ley que regula el uso y las operaciones de los sistemas de aeronaves pilotadas a distancia (RPAS)
annotation.title_en: Supreme Decree No. 012-2026-MTC approving the Regulation of Law No. 30740 regulating the use and operations of remotely piloted aircraft systems (RPAS)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidencia de la República / Ministerio de Transportes y Comunicaciones (Perú)
named_instruments_referenced: Ley Nº 27261 Ley de Aeronáutica Civil del Perú
Reglamento de Infracciones y Sanciones Aeronáuticas
annotation.summary_en: Peruvian Supreme Decree approving the regulation of Law 30740 on remotely piloted aircraft systems (drones). It sets a risk-based Open/Specific/Certified category regime, registration, operator and remote pilot licences, mandatory third-party liability insurance, training centres, and sanctions. Key provisions take effect once DGAC updates technical norms within two years.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three operational categories (Open, Specific, Certified) with escalating licensing and certification requirements
Mandatory registration of RPA/RPAS with DGAC within 30 working days of acquisition
Operator civil liability for damages and mandatory third-party liability insurance with formula-based minimum coverage
Remote pilot licences (min. age 18) and authorised training centres (CIAC)
Open/Specific/Certified provisions enter into force only after DGAC updates NTC 001-2015 and RAPs within two years
